brave.name: Brave
brave.description: Leads from the front: his men strike harder and hold longer.

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.description: Reads a battlefield like a psalter.

inspiring.name: Inspiring
inspiring.description: Men would follow him into the Black Marsh.

siege_master.name: Siege Master
siege_master.description: Knows where every wall is weakest: +20% attack in assaults.

monster_slayer.name: Monster Slayer
monster_slayer.description: Has looked a zmeu in the eye: +15% attack against creatures.

winter_warrior.name: Winter Warrior
winter_warrior.description: His army does not freeze in winter.

beloved.name: Beloved
beloved.description: The people cheer where his army camps: +2 order.

frugal.name: Frugal
frugal.description: Counts every coin: his army costs 15% less.

cruel.name: Cruel
cruel.description: Feared by friend and foe: harder blows, -2 order where he camps.

drunkard.name: Drunkard
drunkard.description: Never in a hurry to leave the tavern: -1 movement.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.description: Keeps a share of the soldiers' pay: his army costs 20% more.
